spans.s:
The affix ष्वुन् (अक्) comes after a verb when the agent so expressed denotes an artist.

Terms: ष्वुन्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose Art' after a word denoting Art in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'whose habit is this' after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ढ comes in the sense of 'like this' after शिला।

Terms: ढ

And when such a compound ending in अण् -affix denotes the name of a professional man, but not when the second term कार(derived from कृञ्), the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the first syllable of the first word.

Terms: समास 1st-acute
